Product Details: Experience powerful and convenient cleaning with the Cockatoo RinseSmart15.0 High Pressure Washer. Engineered for home and light commercial use, this compact electric washer delivers up to 1500W of power with a 2.5HP–5HP peak output, ideal for removing dirt, grime, and stains from cars, bikes, patios, garden tools, and outdoor furniture. The unit produces a maximum pressure of 96 Bar and offers a 6 litres/minute flow rate, enabling high-efficiency washing while conserving water. Its robust aluminium binding brush motor ensures durability, reduced vibration, and stable performance across repeated use. Equipped with a 7-meter high-pressure hose and a 1.8-meter inlet hose, the washer offers excellent flexibility for large surface coverage. The included 2-in-1 spray nozzle allows for adjustable angles between 0° and 150°, providing both focused jet and wide spray options. A 200ml foam bottle is included for effective detergent application and deeper cleaning. Built with a rugged PP body, the washer integrates a Total Stop System (TSS) that automatically shuts off the pump when not in use, improving motor life and energy efficiency. It weighs just 2.7 kg, making it easy to carry and store. The product supports 20 minutes of continuous daily use and comes with a 6-month warranty on the motor.
